ACM Premium Audio.en: As a new international distributor of high-quality hi-fi equipment and a brand-new debutant at the Dutch Audio Event, ACM Premium Audio has one goal: creating the best music experience at home, and taking DAE visitors along on that mission. In Veldhoven the team from Mönchengladbach therefore sets up in the red zone, room 36 to be precise, with an impressive selection of the pan-European top brands these Germans have brought on board. To name a few: ZenSati cables, Node-Audio speakers, Muarah turntables, fonolab SUTs, ACM cartridges, Titanic-Audio accessories, Serblin & Son amplifiers and more.

Aequo Audio.en: Eindhoven-based Aequo Audio can be counted among the most forward-thinking loudspeaker makers in the Netherlands. The Adamantis and Ensium models are a feast for the eyes and ears, as you can experience at DAE. The electronics won’t be the weak link either, judging by the use of models such as the Taiko Audio Extreme Server, the MPT-8 and MPD-8 DAC from Playback Designs, amplification by WestminsterLab and Aequo’s own Aerealis cabling. It’s all about the musical experience the system delivers. Come in, take a seat and enjoy the very best that music and soundstage can offer. Aequo Audio hasn’t been around for long, but it has already left many jaws on the floor, both at home and abroad.

AF Group.en: Why change a winning combination? AF Group from Pistoia in Italy stole the show last year with a combination of Airtech and Audio Analogue, and is simply doing it again in room 37. The setup? A carefully assembled chain built around the Audio Analogue ABsolute 3.0 integrated amplifier, the VOX Prima phono stage from Airtech and the BCD SS-100 mains filter transformer, for those who want ABsolutely no compromises. We may well call the combination of Airtech, Audio Analogue and BCD ‘audiophile art’. Not to be missed.

Analogue Audio Association.en: Saying that vinyl is on the rise is THE understatement of 2026, so the black gold is part of DAE 2026 too. One look at what the Analogue Audio Association has on offer shows that analogue claims a big place. The organisation, originally German, was founded in 1990 and now spreads the analogue word through its Analogue Magazine, published three times a year. There is also plenty of reference material at www.AAAnalog.de, and experiences can be shared on analog-forum.de. Since 2007 AAA has offered copies of original master tapes that have already won a number of awards.

Arpeggio Acoustic.en: Arpeggio Acoustic specialises in building loudspeakers that combine natural timbre with precise phase alignment and timing. The systems breathe a love of the craft and will convince musically. The line-up consists of the Opus I, Opus II, Magnum Opus and Mezzo Opus, all of them praised to the skies. At DAE, Arpeggio plays the Mini Opus for the first time, to give even the most critical listener that immersive listening experience. For comparison the Mezzo Opus will also be used, together with the i/70 from Audio Research and the Lumin X2 streamer.

Aspera Audio.en: Aspera Audio is no stranger to high-end land. As Benelux distributor of brands such as PS Audio and Artesania Audio, it has gone that extra step in experience and service for 50 years. One of those fronts is the Dutch Audio Event, where Aspera Audio lets the PMG Signature amplifiers from PS Audio shine on Artesania Audio’s scientifically grounded isolation systems, which we would normally just call audio racks. It’s incredible what Artesania’s acoustic engineer José Luis Lafarga can achieve with his isolating racks. By the way, the ‘PMG’ on the Signature amplifiers stands for Paul McGowan, founder and owner of PS Audio. Your ears will be happy here…

Audes.en: The history of Estonia’s Audes goes back to 1935, when a group of enthusiasts decided to found RET. Starting with radio receivers, the range has crystallised over the years into an extensive line of premium loudspeakers, tube amplifiers, power conditioners, power strips and power cables. Beyond that, they also make individual drivers and transformers, which says something about their solid expertise. In the Groningenzaal, Audes presents the M5 floorstanding loudspeakers and the NS120SE tube amplifier combined with the NS120PRE preamplifier.

Audessence.en: Audessence is driven by a passion for ultimate sound quality and high-quality audio technology. The company shows a selection of advanced hi-fi and high-end solutions: electronics from EMM Labs and turntables from EMT Tontechnik, in harmony with loudspeakers from Silent Pound.

Audio Group Denmark.en: Audio Group Denmark is a leading Danish maker of high-end audio equipment that brings four specialised brands together under one philosophy: Ansuz (cables and power solutions), Aavik (electronics and amplifiers), Børresen (loudspeakers) and Axxess (accessible high-end audio). The company is known for intensive R&D, applying technologies in resonance control, noise suppression and material innovation across all its brands. In room 45 it will become clear what that means, when the Børresen A-series loudspeakers, combined with the remarkable BM2 folded dipole subwoofer, are demonstrated on the Aavik I-288 integrated amplifier and the Aavik SD-288 streaming DAC. Serious high-end.

AudioQuest.en: AudioQuest is still known worldwide for its high-quality cables, power products and accessories. At DAE, AudioQuest presents the new Star 4 and Star 6 speaker cables. That a good hi-fi system doesn’t have to be expensive (3,000 euros in total) is shown by combining these ‘entry-level’ cables with a WiiM Amp Ultra and Elipson Prestige Facet II 14F loudspeakers. There is also ‘small’ product news from AudioQuest in the form of the DragonFly Copper USB DAC. Twelve years after the original DragonFly, the Copper model shows what is now possible with compact DACs for portable use. It’s no coincidence that AudioQuest managed to create a whole new market segment back then.

Audioscript.en: Audioscript is happy to introduce DAE visitors to three top models from the Japanese high-end brand Luxman. The C in the model names stands for Centennial, which gives away that Luxman is celebrating 100 years. 101 to be precise, as the company is already into its second century. So Audioscript goes big with the L-100C integrated amplifier, the D-100C (SA)CD player and the B-100 Centennial mono power amplifiers. As always with Audioscript and ‘their’ Luxman, this is an absolute must for lovers of refined, emotional sound. Hear how 20 watts per channel can become a real experience.

Auer Acoustics.en: Anyone who has ever talked to Robert Auer knows what this man is made of. Almost literally: he grew from the carpenter’s trade into his second love, music reproduction, and at a remarkably high level at that. The German maker of high-end loudspeakers traditionally combines clean design and modern technology in a sublime way. At DAE he presents the top model of his Versura series, the V6, which promises a new dimension of listening. Its weight of 140 kilos may already give something away, and a knock test will confirm it. Let’s just say Robert doesn’t like nasty resonances. Available in traditional finishes such as walnut and oak, but also, for example, pure orange, shade green metallic, indian red and lugano blue.

Aulo Audio.en: Aulo Audio is a newcomer in the audio firmament. But not just any newcomer. Paul Haex, the man behind Aulo Audio, wanted to present something unique with his Aulo all-in-one Bluetooth turntable. Not something that gets in the way, but a design that actually creates space: a record player with a built-in amplifier, speakers and subwoofer that, for convenience, can also connect over Bluetooth. All in a stylish design, built with premium components. In the Netherlands. Paul proudly shows show visitors his special creation, which gives all-in-one a new dimension. Reviewers from Bright, FWD and GadgetGear are certainly wildly enthusiastic about it.

AVtunes.en: In many audio systems most of the attention goes to amplifiers, loudspeakers and sources. Yet it is often forgotten that furniture, speaker stands and accessories also play an important role in both the performance and the look of an installation. That’s why the extensive NorStone range takes centre stage on the AVTunes stand. At the Dutch Audio Event you can see several series, including the stylish Oslo 1200 in Black Walnut and the Stockholm 700 and 1100.

Bombard.en: The Bombard system is the result of the ambition of two friends: a sound engineer and a DJ-cum-musician from Ronse and Ghent in Belgium, who joined forces with the Bombard OB1 as the result. The OB1 is an active open-baffle loudspeaker system complete with 740 W of class-D amplification, DSP and streaming (from Volumio). The system works out by itself which speaker is left and which is right, and between the two speakers runs a stream of data and sound at 192 kHz/24 bit over I²S via HDMI. No loss, no noise, and perfect timing. The force is strong in these ones…

Bowers & Wilkins.en: Room 53 is set up as a complete HEOS Experience: a full listening experience built around music, ease of use and connection. At the centre of the room are the Denon Home 200, 400 and 600 speakers, designed to make music accessible without sacrificing listening pleasure. With HEOS you can easily play your favourite music on them and use different sources and services in one environment. Whether you already know HEOS or are discovering the system for the first time, room 53 is the place to get to know the platform and the Denon Home speakers. In the Parkzaal, one of the most prestigious loudspeaker lines of the moment awaits you: the all-new Bowers & Wilkins 800 Series Diamond D5. For years the 800 Series has been the technical and aesthetic calling card of Bowers & Wilkins, and the D5 generation underlines that position once again. You may safely call it the most advanced loudspeaker line the maker has developed in the sixty years since it was founded in Worthing. Finally, the Galerij goes big with a sizeable audio museum of equipment. Here visitors can get to know a wide selection of new products, from high-quality stereo and multiroom audio to the latest generation of home cinema and AV receivers. There is also plenty of room for entertainment, with the familiar McLaren Experience (now with a so-called Batak wall to test your reactions and coordination) and a renewed headphone wall.

City Audio Trade.en: The range is generous: power conditioners from Audes, phono amps from Blue Amp, loudspeakers from Chario, amplifiers from Electric Audio, turntables from Holborne, tube amplifiers from MastersounD, DACs from Merason, cables from NxLT, loudspeakers from QLN, cartridges from Skyanalog and the top equipment of Trigon. In room 35 this importer shows how uncompromising high-end audio can sound, demonstrating with the TAE 150 DV from Electric Audio, a newcomer to the range. According to some, the new QLN Prestige Three Gen 2 loudspeakers outperform their legendary predecessor by no less than 30 percent! The digital source is the Merason Reuss DAC, and power comes from the Audes Power Conditioner TT-1700DC. A première: the audio rack from Skyanalog.

D&D Audio.en: D&D Audio guarantees a premier-league hi-fi experience. Its collection includes Astell & Kern, Devialet, SME, VinnieRossi and YG Acoustics. For DAE it has chosen to focus on the electronics of Vitus Audio (the SL-103 preamp, the SME-025 power amps and the SD-025 streaming DAC) combined with loudspeakers from YG Acoustics. Those are in turn connected with D&D’s house cabling from Crystal Cable. Whether the newest turntables from Clearaudio will make it in time for DAE is still an open question, but we can hope! In any case, room 63 promises a lot of beautiful things.

DALI Benelux.en: We know this importer of brands such as NAD, Bluesound, PSB and of course DALI. They offer solutions from entry level to high-end, with a focus on ease of use and innovative technology. At the Dutch Audio Event, DALI Benelux presents various premium solutions for sound quality and ease of use in two rooms. Starting in the Utrecht Foyer, where no fewer than eight(!) EISA Award winners are set up. PSB has the première of a new iQ Series. The open character of the Utrecht Foyer may well make this a very pleasant introduction. In room 83 the demonstrations are with music. Unlike previous years, the choice this time is three budget-friendly sets, to show that real music reproduction at home is possible on a more modest budget too: a set with the NAD C316, the Bluesound Nano and a pair of DALI Kupid; one with the Bluesound Powernode and a pair of DALI Sonik 3; and one with the NAD C3030/S and a pair of DALI Sonik 7.

Daudio.en: Daudio’s open-baffle loudspeakers are characterised by an extremely natural and spacious sound. Without a closed cabinet the music sounds freer and more lifelike, with a wide and deep image as the result. Daudio demonstrates with two systems: the Daudio MOB 2.5, now also available with a 15-inch woofer, and the M1 monitor/subwoofer combination. Both are driven by the Daudio P1000 amplifier, with the Daudio streaming DSD DAC as the source, which now plays up to DSD1024 and has an improved clock and power supply. The cabling is also from Daudio: the Airtubes.

Davone.en: Davone is a Danish maker of exclusive high-end loudspeakers that bring together refined design and high-quality audio engineering. The brand is known for its organic shapes, luxurious materials and timeless look, which let the loudspeakers blend seamlessly into a modern interior. Behind the elegant design lies a well-thought-out acoustic construction with carefully selected components and a high-quality finish. In room 114 you can get to know the Davone Reference Two, which clearly targets the high-end segment and has already been named a classic by HIFI.NL.

dB Module.en: Dutch company dB Module specialises in concrete loudspeakers. It will demonstrate the floorstanding Model 1 and the Model 2E monitor, both proven models that have also tested very well, in HVT among others. Still, there is a première to report: dB Module introduces no fewer than two new variants of the Model 2E, with different tweeters and available in several colours. Room 16 has fixed demonstrations at 11:00, 13:00, 14:30 and 16:00, and there will also be presentations on the design of the concrete loudspeakers.

Dimex.en: While Dimex’s portfolio includes brands such as Adot, Atohm, Dela, Diptyque, Kora, Nuprime and Silent Angel, it has decided to focus in the Meijerij Foyer on the new products from Cambridge Audio: the EVO 300 streaming amplifier and the L/R X active loudspeakers. The EVO 300 builds on the design of the EVO 150SE, combining streaming, amplification and plenty of connections in one box. The L/R X is the top model of the newly launched L/R series and good for no less than 400 watts each. They combine power, scale and musical honesty in a compact design that effortlessly fills larger rooms. And they look amazing too!

Driade.en: With the Premium Model 2S+, Premium Model 3S+ and Premium Model 9, Driade shows the characteristic loudspeakers we have come to expect from them. Specifications can tell you how a loudspeaker is built, but not what music does to you. That’s why Driade above all invites you to come and listen. The three models share a clear family sound (natural, fast, transparent, precise and spacious) while looking quite different from one another. At the show, the remarkable Soulnote A-2 integrated amplifier is the beating heart of the system.

Dutch & Dutch.en: Martijn Mensink of Dutch & Dutch comes to demonstrate ‘his’ innovative cardioid active loudspeaker systems in person. They combine advanced DSP technology with acoustic refinement, so they can be tuned perfectly to any room and placed close to the rear wall. The result is precise, transparent sound with impressive dynamics and control, without the need for external amplifiers or complex cabling. But don’t take our word for it: go and listen for yourself to the well-known Model 8c and the compact newcomer Model 6c, which measures just 38 x 22 x 31 cm, weighs 14 kilos and will make your trouser legs flap to the music.

Dynaudio Benelux.en: Besides its Danish loudspeakers, importer Dynaudio Benelux this year also brings a brand-new product it has taken under its wing: the tube amplifiers of Germany’s Octave. Dynaudio loudspeakers are known worldwide for their natural sound, musical balance and elegant design. Dynaudio’s Legends meet those criteria like no other. These compact monitors look stunning in rosewood and, despite their modest size, deliver a beautiful, wide and deep soundstage. From the flagship range, Dynaudio will play the Confidence 30i. In both cases Octave handles the amplification. For the Confidence 30i a preamplifier from the HP series and a power amp from the MRE series will be used, and an integrated amplifier from the V series will make the Legends sing with joy. You really have to come and listen to this.

Electric Ivy.en: This Belgian distributor specialises in exclusive high-end audio brands for the Benelux. Its carefully assembled portfolio includes Boenicke Audio, Vertere and Basel Acoustics, each of them makers known for innovative engineering and uncompromising sound quality. You’ll find the first in room 9, where its expertise is underlined with a fine selection from the range of the Swiss loudspeaker brand. Boenicke is known for its idiosyncratic designs, compact dimensions and above all an approach to loudspeaker development centred on the music experience. Electric Ivy has selected four models to take you into the brand’s world: the W5 Mk2, W8 Mk2, W11 Mk2 and W13 Mk2. In room 13 the spotlight is on Basel and Vertere, with as eye-catcher the Basel Acoustics V01, a loudspeaker that stands out for its distinctive design and attention to detail. Vertere provides the analogue pleasure with the DG X turntable.

ERCT.en: Look at ERCT’s portfolio and you’ll understand why this distributor occupies three rooms: ERCT carries 27 (!) brands. In room 115 the team will play two sets. The first is built entirely from high-end components by Mavis Lab. The Mavis MP1 preamplifier will drive the Master 15 MKII horn loudspeakers through the P200 monoblocks and show what this Vietnamese brand stands for. The analogue magic comes from the Giro MKII turntable by AMG. The second high-end set is partly carved in stone, literally: we mean the loudspeakers from Fischer & Fischer, in this case the 570. They are driven by the Electrocompaniet AW800 stereo power amplifier combined with the brand’s new C5 preamplifier. The source is the Rockna Wavedream Signature Reference streaming DAC. The cabling in set two comes from France’s Roboli. Room 117 has a ‘small’ set consisting of Grand Avantgarde loudspeakers from Gershman Acoustics, driven by the Accustic Arts Power III power amplifier and the AudioByte SuperHUB with SuperVOX. The cabling is from Audiomica. ERCT of course needs more space to show the bulk of the rest of its range to visitors, and will do so in the Kempenzaal.

Fine Sounds Benelux.en: While things have changed at importer Fine Sounds Benelux after the takeover by the Bose group, it’s business as usual for the Sonus faber and McIntosh brands. In fact, at DAE they demonstrate with the new Sonus faber Olympica G3, complemented by a Gravis V subwoofer from the same brand. Amplification comes from the also-new McIntosh MA2375 integrated amplifier, fed by a McIntosh DS200 streaming DAC as source and relying on the McIntosh MT10 for vinyl. Room 65 will also be furnished with various Sonus faber loudspeakers from the Olympica series, and we get to see premières from McIntosh: the CS7500 streaming preamplifier and the MX124 AV processor.

GIK Acoustics.en: If you’re thinking about acoustic treatment for your listening room, GIK Acoustics has all kinds of solutions for you. The range can safely be called broad, with a portfolio of panels, bass traps, diffusers and modular systems. Besides the product presentations, GIK Acoustics’ experts are there on both days to advise on listening rooms, home cinemas, studios and other spaces where sound plays an important role. You can drop by the stand without an appointment to discuss your acoustic challenges with them.

GP Acoustics.en: GP Acoustics’ room is all about the newest models from KEF and Hegel, plus a few trusted combinations of the two brands. Three sets are playing: the Hegel H30a/P30a amplifier duo on the imposing Blade One META, the brand-new KEF LS LUXE active speakers with KC62 subwoofers, and, as the icing on the cake, the equally brand-new Hegel H200 on the KEF R11 Meta. Set one may be a trusted combination, but that doesn’t make it any less impressive. Set three focuses mainly on introducing the H200 ‘The Connected’, with a digital and streaming section. As the A200 ‘The Classic’, this amplifier focuses mainly on analogue. Still, the biggest crowd will probably be at the KEF LS LUXE all-in-one streaming system, which sits between the latest LS50 and LS60 Wireless versions. Especially with the KEF KC62 subs, set two is ‘The One’ not to miss. But beware: the sound is addictive and may give the hi-fi virus free rein!

Grimm Audio.en: As important as ASML is for chips, so is Grimm Audio, whose streamers and loudspeakers have left a huge mark on high-end audio. That’s why the Dutch Audio Event is unthinkable without them, even though it’s a home game for the Veldhoven-based company. Besides the now well-known MU1 and MU2, Grimm will let the public hear its new PA1 monoblocks. As if these amplifiers weren’t special enough in design and sound, the company felt compelled to develop new passive(!) Grimm loudspeakers to really get the most out of the PA1 amplifiers. It started as a study project but then got seriously out of hand, if we may believe figureheads Eelco Grimm and Guido Tent. Both are in room 116 to explain it all and to play music. They hold their own in both digital and analogue, as shown by the recent JPLAY certification of the MUs and the use of the PW1 with a beautiful turntable combination.

GVR Audio Import.en: In the Boszaal, GVR Audio Import will truly claim visitors’ full attention with no fewer than two high-end sets. The long side of the Boszaal holds the main set, where Leema handles the amplification with the Lybra preamplifier and the Hydra II Anniversary monoblocks. The digital sources are the Leema Antilla CD player and the Leema streamer, while the analogue side is covered by an Acoustic Solid 733 tower with a Sorane arm and a Van Den Hul HIGH END MC cartridge made especially for the Dutch Audio Event. Van den Hul cabling then carries the music to the Audio Physic Cardeas loudspeakers. On the short side of the hall there is a more affordable set consisting of the Leema i85 amplifier with DAC, the Leema CD100, the Acoustic Solid 111 with an AT cartridge and a pair of Audio Physic Stream 3 loudspeakers.

Headfinest Distribution.en: THE head-fi specialist of the Benelux and far beyond can of course not be missing from the fast-growing Headspace at the Dutch Audio Event. In the Holland Foyer, Headfinest Distribution once again brings an impressive selection of brands and products, from compact desktop solutions to high-quality streaming, DACs and of course personal audio in and on your ears. Once again, there is a lot to discover.

Hear Everything Audio Import & Tonality.en: With brands such as C.E.C., Merrill Audio and Guru, importer Hear Everything more than lives up to its name. From C.E.C. the CD2N CD player is demonstrated, while the Clay Michael preamplifier from Merrill Audio feeds a pair of Musical Fidelity M8s-700m power amplifiers. The Apex 52 loudspeakers from Guru complete the picture. Room 7 also sees the appearance of the new Tonality Import, demonstrating a world-class set built around AirTight’s ATM300BR power amplifier and ATC7 reference preamplifier on the Falcon M30 monitors. There are also demonstrations with the active Opus-1 loudspeakers from Avantgarde Acoustic. Their portfolio further includes brands such as Rogers, Riviera Audio Laboratories and Furutech. A fine list, but in the end only one thing counts: do you get goosebumps? Room 7 is all about brands that don’t keep the music neatly between the loudspeakers, but fill your room with experience and emotion. Each brand has its own character and a unique impact. Expect anything but uniformity here.

Helios & Audio Essence.en: You’ll find Helios Pro Audio Solutions in Veldhoven in its familiar setting, where expertise, listening experience and product demonstrations come together in one place. All the attention goes to a selection of top brands that stand for exceptional sound quality and technological innovation. In the spotlight this year is a special première: one of only 50 pairs of the ATC EL50 Anniversary, the latest evolution of ATC’s legendary 50 series. The room is shared with Audio Essence, which specialises in high-quality audio products for music lovers who want to get the most out of their system. From Leeuwarden, the company exclusively represents brands such as PliXiR and focuses on power supply, cabling, vibration control and system optimisation.

Hi-Stands.en: Hi-Stands has specialised in audio furniture and accessories since it was founded on 21 May 2008. Over time its passion and expertise have grown into a wider range of audio and video accessories. Adding CDs and LPs was a natural step for the company, given its love of music. It has a curated collection of both classical and contemporary music. Hi-Stands’ goal has always been to offer customers a complete experience, not just by supplying quality products but above all through expertise and a passion for audio and video.

Hifi Corner Trading.en: Under the inspiring leadership of Willy Van de Velde, Hifi Corner Trading comes with two special new products that are central to the development of Peter Lyngdorf’s brands: the Lyngdorf TDAI-2210 and the Radiant Acoustics Clarity 66. The TDAI-2210 shows how amplification, streaming and room correction can be integrated ever further, while the Clarity 66 lets you hear what is possible when loudspeaker design is approached entirely from control, low distortion and musical coherence. What makes it extra special is that both products have just won an EISA Award. To complete the picture, Peter Lyngdorf himself will be in room 1 to let you hear why that praise is fully deserved. Be warned: Peter’s demos are special and may lead to an urge to buy!

HiFiMatters.en: At HiFiMatters, DAE is all about Takumi, the Dutch turntable brand of designer Rik Stoet. See the TT Level 1.1 (€1,295), the TT Level 2.1DC with electronic SpeedPod control and of course the all-new TT Level 3.1. The Takumi MC cartridges are on show too, with various stylus shapes and cantilevers. Drop by, see the turntables and cartridges up close and discover the technology and ideas behind Takumi. The designer himself is there to explain it all. This stand also has the latest from a few other brands in HiFiMatters’ portfolio, such as DasL, Moonriver and Stirling Broadcast.

Highend Music.en: Highend Music is a Dutch distributor of high-end audio with a strong passion for music and high-quality sound reproduction. From Zwolle, the company supports a network of specialist hi-fi dealers with product training, technical expertise and personal service. Its brand portfolio includes Pro-Ject, Musical Fidelity and Triangle, each of them makers known for excellent value for money and innovative audio engineering. Father and son Oosterveld once again have two completely different systems in store to underline that: one for an accessible budget, based on the Triangle Solstice 3 loudspeakers, and one of serious high-end, based on the Triangle Magellan 40th Duetto.

House of Music.en: This Belgian distributor presents a selection of products that let you discover how versatile modern hi-fi can be. House of Music represents renowned brands such as Revival Audio, MoFi Electronics, Elipson, Advance Paris, Music Hall and WiiM. From Revival Audio, the Grande Réserve loudspeakers are presented, showing why the brand is making waves in high-end audio. The SourcePoint V10 loudspeakers from MoFi Electronics can’t be missing, and neither can the Legacy II 3220 from Elipson. Advance Paris debuts the NOVA A-i190 integrated amplifier, and Music Hall shows the Stealth high-end turntable. Finally, the WiiM products highlight the other side of the audio firmament, led by the hit WiiM Amp Ultra.

IDC Klaassen.en: IDC Klaassen works with a carefully selected network of specialist hi-fi dealers in the Benelux and supports them with product training, technical expertise, marketing and excellent service. Its brand portfolio includes CANOR, Creek Audio, EPOS, FinkTeam, Goldring, IsoTek, Q Acoustics, QED, Blue Horizon and Milty. Two brands from the range, CANOR and Q Acoustics, get all the attention. In their room we find the Q Acoustics 5050, the flagship floorstander of the 5000 series. On the electronics side there is the Canor Verto D4S, a combined DAC and preamplifier, and the Canor Virtus integrated amplifier from the Foundation Line. The cabling chosen is QED XT40i speaker cable.

IsoAcoustics Nederland.en: This importer can of course not be missing. IsoAcoustics’ innovative isolation solutions improve the clarity, focus and spaciousness of both loudspeakers and studio equipment by minimising vibrations and resonances. Whether monitors, floorstanders or subwoofers, IsoAcoustics products give tighter bass, a more open midrange and a more precise stereo image, which will be shown in a live demonstration with loudspeakers from Focal. Extra attention goes to the Neo decouplers, and the Neo Titan has its première. The DELOS platform is also on show, which recently scored highly in a review in HVT.

Joenit.en:
This Belgian importer presents a combination of British precision and Canadian musicality. From Chord Electronics, the Quartet upscaler and the Ultima Phonostage are presented, which immediately bridge to Rega’s Planar PL6 RS turntable with the RB880 arm and Ania cartridge. Rega’s AOS is an uncompromising, fully adjustable MC preamplifier whose circuit design is based on Rega’s award-winning Aura, the MC phono stage from its reference series.

The loudspeakers are the Totem Tribe Tower Thunderbird and the Metal V2. New at Joenit are the loudspeakers from Kerr Acoustic. The compact K400 monitor is presented and will amaze you with what can come out of a small loudspeaker.

Joep Slooten.en: Furniture maker and speaker builder Joep Slooten from Rotterdam makes his DAE debut. At his stand you’ll find both high-quality active loudspeakers and special hi-fi furniture and solid-wood vinyl racks. With them he wants to show you how traditional craftsmanship and modern digital technology can strengthen each other. Besides the speakers, Slooten shows various pieces of hi-fi furniture in the Koningshof. One eye-catcher is the Las Palmas hi-fi cabinet, inspired by the building of the same name on the Maas in his home city. His special vinyl racks in solid walnut are part of his collection too. His audio furniture is entirely made to measure and can be made in solid wood or veneer, with round shapes among its signature elements.

KAD Audio.en: This year Kaempfer Audio Design presents the completely renewed K5-EVO for the first time. The new stand-mount top model is again active and DSP-managed, but now upgraded with a new amplifier unit fitted with three separate Hypex class-D amplifiers, a powerful DSP and a triple DAC. The unit also offers wired AES or wireless WiSA connections. The K5 monitor gives essentially the same sound experience as the EVO, but does so with half the power, different drivers and a simpler cabinet construction. Serious home-grown high-end audio.

Kii Audio.en: Kii Audio presents its advanced, compact Kii SEVEN and its bigger brother, the Kii THREE, active loudspeakers known for their unique cardioid radiation pattern and integrated DSP technology. This design minimises reflections from walls and gives an extremely precise stereo image, even in challenging rooms. The Kii systems combine amplification, filtering and room compensation in one enclosure, making external equipment largely unnecessary. If desired, the Kii THREE can be expanded with the Kii THREE BXT extension modules, which add a total of 16(!) actively driven drivers to the system.

KlangQ.en: KlangQ presents a complete high-end audio set centred on natural reproduction, timing and musical expression, thanks to names such as SW1X, PrimaryControl and Miyajima. The set in room 22 is built around the SW1X MTR 963 Field Coil loudspeakers. The digital sources are the SW1X VDT IV Valve Digital Transport and the SW1X DAC V. For vinyl, the PrimaryControl Kinea II is used, fitted with the Gravity magnetically stabilised unipivot tonearm and the Arrow precision tonearm. The set includes the Miyajima Destiny stereo MC cartridge and a special Miyajima mono MC cartridge for mono recordings. The SW1X SUT II MC step-up transformer ensures a quiet, harmonious and dynamic transfer from low-output MC cartridges.

Latham Audio.en: Naim Audio, The Chord Company and Focal guarantee a sublime listening experience, each in its own field and extremely versatile. Focal’s loudspeakers and headphones are both in a class of their own. The main room is room 54, which gives the stage to Focal’s Scala EVO M. This showpiece is driven by a complete Naim 300 system: the NAC-332 preamplifier, the NSS-333 network player, the NAP-350 power amplifier and the NPX-300 power supply. The digital side of the set is handled by the NSS-333 network player. In the Kempenzaal a Kia EV5 is on display, fitted with a Focal Car set from the aforementioned Flax series. With it, Latham Audio shows and lets you hear that this field is part of its expertise too.

Linear HiFi.en: Music is emotion, a story, and you can only truly experience the core of that message with good equipment. At least, that is the philosophy of audio distributor Linear. The brands it uses for that mission are Cyrus Audio and Unitra, with the spotlight at the show on the Cyrus 80 Series and the handsome Unitra Edmund GSH-801 record player. Room 110 is all about the Cyrus 80 series, Cyrus’ first full-size component range, consisting of the 80AMP streaming amplifier, 80PRE preamplifier and 80PWR power amplifier. In the Friesland Foyer you can get to know Unitra, the relatively new brand from Poland, on a larger scale for the first time. The products are on static display here. A Unitra product specialist is there to talk to you and explain the products. The Cyrus 40 series will also get extra attention here.

Livet Audio.en: Dutch company Livet Audio presents a carefully assembled selection of German products for the true music lover. To start with, the T+A A 3100 HV integrated amplifier and the T+A SDX 3100 HV streaming DAC and preamplifier. The massive construction alone inspires confidence, and that’s before the machines are even switched on. By combining meticulous refinements with fundamentally new innovations, the SDX 3100 HV and the A 3100 HV completely redefine T+A’s approach to signal processing and power amplification. Precision and dynamics are what Inakustik cabling promises, and the fifth generation of AIR Helix cables proves it. These cables are therefore used in the demonstrations of both T+A products, which will let visitors experience what German thoroughness really stands for when engineering and musicality come together.

Loewe Opta Benelux.en: The Loewe Opta Benelux team is happy to show you how a television is becoming more and more part of the interior. At the centre of the setup in room 61 are the Loewe antares and Loewe stellar ti: two OLED televisions that combine picture quality, advanced technology and distinctive design. Although both models clearly follow the same Loewe philosophy, each has its own emphasis. Come and discover it for yourself!

Lyssna Acoustics.en: Lyssna Acoustics combines minimalism with a warm listening experience. From quiet mornings to long evenings, sound that transforms rooms and brings back memories… We’re always excited when we can announce a brand-new brand, especially when that brand has chosen DAE to present itself for the first time. Lyssna Acoustics is a Dutch company and a completely new loudspeaker brand with a clear vision of high-quality reproduction. Under the name Lyssna Modular, the brand introduces a modular system that combines flexibility, performance and a contemporary design. More information at www.lyssna-acoustics.com.

Monitor Audio Nederland.en: In room 12, importer Monitor Audio Nederland naturally plays loudspeakers from Monitor Audio: the floorstanding 8G from the Silver series and the compact Radius 3 4G monitor. While the first impresses with its size and generally sturdy look, the second will surprise with its compact size and big sound. To get this out of the loudspeakers, the new Caspian 4G streaming and power amplifier is used. The two small giants from Monitor Audio stand rock-solid on AXIS stands from Blok.

MIKA.en: As importer and distributor of top-quality audio brands, MIKA sets the tone for the range in many showrooms in the Benelux. At DAE you can count on a fine mix of established hi-fi brands and surprising newcomers: Canton, Leak, Mission and Wharfedale. Attention for the Wharfedale Linton Heritage from the last of these, and a première in the form of the Wharfedale EVO 5.4. Also here are the Mission 778X amplifier and the Mission 778S streamer, which feed music to Canton Vento loudspeakers.

More Music.en: More Music’s presentation is all about musical experience, high-quality technology and how the different components work together. The ‘main system’ is built around the Aurender N50 as digital source, combined with a dCS DAC and a MOON 891 preamplifier. Amplification comes from two MOON 861 power amplifiers, which together drive the imposing Estelon X Diamond Signature loudspeakers. Power and cabling come from Shunyata. Besides the brands demonstrated directly in the systems, More Music presents a wider brand portfolio, including Aurender, Bassocontinuo, dCS, Estelon, Finite Elemente, MOON, Pass Labs, PrimaLuna and Shunyata.

Music Emotion.en: Music Emotion is a Dutch publisher of high-end audio and music titles, in print and online. Van der Geld is the publishing house behind this series of leading music magazines and platforms, with an eye for in-depth content and quality journalism. FWD Magazine focuses specifically on audio, music and lifestyle, and offers readers inspiring articles, reviews and background stories. At DAE they invite visitors to explore the subscription options for one or more of their titles. Subscribe, and you’ll certainly go home with a nice gift too!

Music2 Audio Import.en: Importer Music2 Audio Import made a serious debut last year: in the Tuinzaal, a carefully assembled set around Blumenhofer Acoustics, Trafomatic, Reed, Dr. Feickert and Grimm Audio became, entirely as expected, one of THE trendsetters of the show. This edition, however, things are a little different… This time the analogue audio specialist presents itself from the Kempenzaal, where it comes with a special première: the introduction of AudioHub, a new European cooperation concept that brings together various high-quality audio brands and specialists. A special eye-catcher there is the Von Schweikert Ultra 11 loudspeakers. After all, the eye wants something too.

Musical Reality.en: A unique collection of high-end audio brands and equipment in one place: that’s an intro that could be written for a large share of the Koningshof’s listening rooms on 10 and 11 October. Still, the audio system in the Kempenzaal, put together with great attention and care, is one you absolutely must not miss. For Musical Reality it makes no difference whether it’s a small music system for a small room or the complete fit-out of a listening room where anything is possible: it all revolves around the customer’s needs. The audio tools used are ModWright’s tube amplifiers combined with loudspeakers from Von Schweikert and source components from EERA.

Necto Systems.en: Necto Systems, known for B-systems, Pursonic, Trivum and Gineos, will focus at the show mainly on the last of these, the most recent brand in the organisation. Gineos is a sub-brand of B-systems. Where B-systems targets the professional built-in and installation market, Gineos was developed as a consumer brand. As last year, B-systems and Necto Systems themselves are there too.

New Transtec.en: This Dutch importer presents a carefully assembled selection of three renowned audio brands: QUAD, VTL and Castle. QUAD has the biggest presence, with an extensive overview of both electronics and loudspeakers. From the new QUAD Platina series, for example, the Platina integrated amplifier and the Platina streamer with built-in DAC are presented. The QUAD 3 series is on show too, including the QUAD 3 preamplifier, the QUAD 33 preamplifier and the QUAD 303 power amplifier. These electronics are an important part of the QUAD range and show different approaches to pre- and power amplification. Loudspeakers have a prominent place at QUAD as well: visitors can get to know the impressive QUAD ESL 2912X electrostatic loudspeaker, the QUAD Revela and the brand-new QUAD Elegan.

Our Musical Soul.en: Our Musical Soul from Brasschaat in Belgium makes its show debut with a carefully assembled high-end audio set built around musical experience, technology and craftsmanship. That special set is in room 44, where French loudspeaker building from JMR, Greek tube technology from LAB 12 and Swiss cabling from, how could it be otherwise, Swisscables come together. The big attraction may well be the French JMR Auralis loudspeakers. Our Musical Soul invites you to come and listen not so much to an audio system, but above all to the music that will be played.

PAI audio/video.en: PAI has some very fine brands in its range, including Primare and Perlisten, which you can enjoy in room 18. In the Limburg Foyer, the hi-fi and home cinema specialist presents the newest generation of loudspeakers from Denmark’s System Audio, specifically the Legend 5.2 Silverback DS and the larger Legend 40.2 Silverback DS. System Audio (SA) is known for its combination of Scandinavian design, smart technology and a musical approach to loudspeaker development. In room 18 the demo is built around a full 7.2.4 home cinema system. The lead role goes to Perlisten’s X- and D-series speakers, which create a spacious and dynamic soundstage in which both subtle details and big action scenes come across convincingly. The amplification comes from Primare: the SPA25 Prisma handles most of the channels and is complemented by an A35.2 power amplifier for the left and right channels. That makes a powerful and controlled foundation for the full 7.2.4 setup.

Pearl Acoustics.en: Pearl Acoustics was founded by Harley Lovegrove, a Brit who has spent most of his life in Belgium. The design of the first loudspeaker, the Sibelius, named after the Finnish composer, is based on a single driver. That principle has stayed, but the brand now has more models, albeit under different names: the Model One and Model Two. The latter will be shown for the first time at the Dutch Audio Event, as a première. But Pearl Acoustics now makes amplifiers too. Both models, the 7040 class-D amplifier and the 170 tube amplifier, come from Ealing in England. Harley Lovegrove is a versatile audio fanatic: besides two loudspeaker models and two amplifiers, our Brit/Belgian also has a turntable mat in the range.

Penhold.en: At DAE, importer Penhold comes with a wide choice of brands and products that will come to life together in surprising ways. Besides various novelties and premières, no fewer than three products from the range have been honoured with an EISA Award for 2026/2027: the Fezz Titania MK2 stereo amplifier, the Paradigm Premier 820F floorstander and the Thorens TD 404 DD. As a première, Penhold presents the Michi Prestige Series, consisting of the X430 integrated amplifier, the P430 preamplifier/DAC and the Q430 CD player. And speaking of premières, we should certainly mention the Lumin N1 network switch and a striking Lumin network player whose name we don’t even know yet. Demonstrations use the Paradigm Premier Series V2 loudspeakers, EISA winners along with the Premier 820F. Besides the Thorens TD 404 DD, the ultimate high-end Thorens TD 124 DD Exclusive will also make an appearance, by popular request.

Qobuz.en: This French streaming provider has gained enormously in popularity in recent years. With an ever-growing music catalogue and number of subscribers, the service is increasingly embraced by the high-end community and high-end manufacturers alike. You see Qobuz Connect mentioned more and more often as an option on streaming devices of any quality. It’s also striking that Qobuz keeps developing its app. Quality is exactly what Qobuz is betting on: lossless and hi-res streaming of both classical and contemporary content. Qobuz does what many promise: bring music as the artist intended it. At the Dutch Audio Event, visitors can experience for themselves how easy it is to listen in studio quality.

Reference Sounds.en: Bringing You Closer is the motto of this importer of special high-end audio. Good sound is much more than a beautiful product. It’s a total experience where atmosphere and technology come together. With the right synergy between the products and the room, good turns into magic (hint). Not an easy task at a show, but this importer once again goes all in! They do so in two rooms, with a number of new products from their impressive line-up. The source of the playing set in both rooms is the WADAX Studio Player, supported in set 1 by the Studio PSU and Studio Clock. For amplification, set 1 uses the new Progression NEO series from Dan D’Agostino Master Audio Systems, and set 2 relies on the big Audio Research amplifiers. That makes sense, as these have to drive the loudspeakers from Magico, a newcomer to the portfolio. For cabling they rely on Transparent Reference Series cabling, and for a stable base on Harmonic Resolutions rack systems. With carefully placed Telos Power Isolation and Grounding, they give the electronics the ultimate stage to show their qualities.

Rhapsody Import.en: Rhapsody Import brings some of its finest brands to Veldhoven, with lead roles for, among others, the fantastic high-end solutions of TLA (True Life Audio). The brand’s imposing amplifiers drive a pair of Wilson Benesch Resolution 3zero loudspeakers, fed musically by both Pink Faun and Döhmann and Thiele to serve both the streamers and the analogue lovers at the show. One of the absolute eye-catchers is Greece’s TLA, a maker known for its uncompromising hybrid amplifier designs. At the centre of the demonstration is the impressive TLA TSI-300 integrated hybrid amplifier. With this combination of analogue and digital sources, uncompromising amplification, innovative loudspeakers and well-thought-out system optimisation from Schnerzinger, Diamond Sound and Ictra Design, Rhapsody Import lets you experience how far high-end audio has come. A demonstration that isn’t about individual products, but about the total musical experience when every part of the chain plays at reference level.

RMR Soundsystems.en: On the RMR Soundsystems stand we find yet another première, this time from Sivian Acoustics. For the first time you can see the new Larissa 350BI-D REF integrated amplifier with DA converter, combined with the newest loudspeakers from the Almathea series. Both the cabling and the decoupling products are from the British brand Townshend. Toni from Townshend will be there to explain the products.

Semmaa Audio.en: Semmaa Audio has two loudspeakers in its range, the Small Reality and the Reality One. The first is a fairly compact monitor on a stand, the second a high-end modular system in which the drivers for the highs, mids and lows sit in three separately adjustable enclosures. The crossovers are external too, and without circuit boards. This year Sem and Maarten, who gave the brand its name, are at the show for the third year in a row, and they think third time’s the charm by demonstrating with amplifiers from YcA. The letters stand for Yori custom Audio, and Yori van Gelderop is the one who approached Sem and Maarten at DAE last year to ask whether they were open to working together. The result is a treat of incredible realism when listeners in room 17 get to know the synergy between Yori’s amplifiers and Sem and Maarten’s loudspeakers.

Siltech Group.en: Siltech Cables, renowned worldwide as a maker of high-end audio cables, appears at the Dutch Audio Event for the first time this year. At this leading show, Siltech proudly presents the brand-new Legend MKII line, as well as products from HMS Kabels. A special highlight is the addition of a new entry-level model to the Legend series: the Legend MKII 280. This series is made entirely from a silver-gold alloy, a signature Siltech technology, and is offered at an attractive entry price. That makes the show the perfect moment to get an accessible introduction to the exceptional quality and craftsmanship of Siltech cables. Various staff are there, including members of the production team and the sales department. They are ready to talk to you personally, answer questions and give insight into the craft behind the cables.

Sonos Europe.en: Who doesn’t know this brand? You could say Sonos shaped today’s hi-fi market almost single-handedly. One of the brand’s pillars is of course the Sonos app, which works brilliantly, and the second is its well-designed line-up. At DAE, Sonos makes that system even more complete with the introduction of the Sonos Ace Ultra headphones and the Sonos Beam Ultra soundbar. The ‘Ultra’ raises expectations. In Sonos’ own words, we should now rather speak of a sound system, designed down to the last detail to make you feel something. Forget the calibrated acoustics and the software analyses behind it. This is a system that pierces straight through your soul. Love the sound. Feel the system.

Sonova Consumer Hearing.en: The German head-fi specialists of Sennheiser can of course not be missing from the biggest audio show in their neighbouring country. The maker from Wennebostel shows, and of course lets you hear, its latest developments in high-quality headphones and wireless audio. On the show floor several recent models take centre stage, including the Sennheiser MOMENTUM 5 Wireless, the MOMENTUM True Wireless 5 and the remarkable HDB 630, the brand’s first wireless audiophile headphone. With these products Sennheiser proves once again that premium sound quality doesn’t have to stay in the listening room, but works perfectly well on the move too.

Sound Coach.en: Sound Coach has grown into a specialist in high-quality acoustic solutions for listening rooms, studios and home cinemas. From acoustic measurements and design to production and installation, all custom solutions are made entirely in-house. Recently it also has its own loudspeakers: Audio Wizard. Sound Coach made a successful debut at the previous edition with demonstrations of prefab acoustic elements and information on how to set up a room optimally in acoustic terms.

SPL Electronics.en: At the show, SPL Electronics presents a special combination of four German brands: SPL, Transrotor, Manger and beaudioful. As exhibitor, SPL brings these brands together around one shared conviction: high-quality audio is not just about technology, but also about craftsmanship, sustainability, design and above all the experience of music. In the Galerij, SPL is represented with a static presentation of its own products, such as the Crossover MkII, the Phonitor xe, the Phonos duo and the Performer s900. If you want to see (and hear!) the complete quartet of brands, you are welcome in room 24.

SPL Electronics & Manger Audio.en: Back to the SPL Crossover MkII, because it plays a role in the high-end demo system. It’s an external analogue crossover you can set yourself, for use with speakers that have terminals for bi-amping/bi-wiring, such as the Manger Audio p2, which combines the characteristic W06 Manger sound transducer with an 8-inch woofer and two passive radiators. That just begs for a crossover, doesn’t it? The musical source in the setup is Transrotor, which has been developing and building turntables in Germany since 1971. The whole is completed by beaudioful, whose RÄCK-R shows that high-end audio and interior design naturally go together.

STS Digital.en: At the Dutch Audio Event you can discover at STS Records what is possible when recording quality and musical passion come together. As a specialist in high-quality analogue and digital recordings, STS Records delivers productions with exceptional dynamics, detail and timbre. Their recordings are loved by audiophiles worldwide and are often used as reference material when testing hi-fi equipment. Visitors can get to know a wide range of genres, all recorded with the characteristic STS signature: pure, natural and with respect for the musical intention.

STUdo-Hifi & Horn-Kultur.en: Room 112 has two high-end exhibitors with no fewer than two premières. STUdo-Hifi presents the STUdo 20 turntable with a floating 20-inch tonearm, a première for DAE. From Horn-Kultur we find the newest version of their Corneo loudspeakers with a spherical horn in birch plywood, première number two. These components will be played on Horn-Kultur amplifiers: the brand’s adjustable tube monoblocks with the 807 tube, currently a pre-production model without final finish (a pre-première?), together with the Audreal LP1 (MM) phono preamplifier with step-up transformer. A real treat!

Symphonic Line.en: The brand shown here is the creation of Rolf Gemein, the last active founder of High End 1981 and co-founder of the North German Hi-Fi Days. Every unit is made to order and personally fine-tuned! The selection, combination and unheard-of quality of the components used are exceptional. These integrated amplifiers are considered the very best musical buy in their respective price classes! For 25 years the RG 14 Edition has been THE reference amplifier for various publications, such as the well-known Stereo. Rolf introduced the update for his equipment in 1982 and has won numerous awards for the best show presentation. As the ultimate recognition, this year he received a Lifetime Achievement Award from the AAA, together with Aalt Jouk Van den Hul.

Symphony Audio Import.en: Symphony Audio Import brings together a special selection of international high-end brands, including the SL1, JL5HPA and JL7HPA pre- and power amplification from Convergent Audio Technology (CAT), Lynx loudspeakers from Rockport and a turntable from TechDAS, the AF4, fitted with a Graham Elite arm. Besides this set there is attention for MC Systems, whose MP3.1 and B3 will be shown. Expect a combination of refined engineering, musical experience and surprising systems that show how much emotion and detail music can hold. A great opportunity to get to know special brands and new favourite combinations.

Temporal Coherence & Hepta Design Audio.en: Two brands working with passion, precision and craftsmanship towards a shared goal: reproducing music as naturally and immersively as possible, without audible artefacts or technical noise. One of the eye-catchers is the Temporal Coherence Pyramide: an active, omnidirectional, time-coherent audio system in which all the electronics were developed and built by Temporal Coherence itself. The CA 020 amplifier, also a Temporal Coherence product, drives everything. Besides the CA 020, the successful cooperation with Hepta Design Audio is demonstrated again with the PA 080 H power amplifier, which together with the preamplifier takes turns playing music on Hepta’s Orator and Emmarantus loudspeakers. The limitations in the bass of the acoustic cabinet are corrected electronically by the CA 020. The PA 080 H in turn fits seamlessly into many settings, can be used universally and does exactly what it was made for: driving loudspeakers without flinching.

Terrason Audio.en: Over the past decades Terrason Audio has become the symbol of high-end, with brands that live up to expectations but come with matching price tags. That image needs adjusting. Look at Terrason Audio’s complete portfolio, featuring brands such as Halcro, Grimm Audio and Vivid Audio, and you know this segment is still an important part of the range, but Terrason Audio does so much more. The demonstrations at the Dutch Audio Event are therefore all about two brands, Arcam and Accuvoice. Terrason Audio demonstrates with two sets. The first consists of components from Arcam: the loudspeakers, the amplifiers and the sources are all from the new Radia series. The second set simply consists of a pair of Stream 3 loudspeakers from Accuvoice. Accuvoice is a contraction of ‘accurate’ and ‘voice’. The brand is new, but the Swedish team behind Accuvoice has expertise going back to the 1990s. The Stream 3 is a modern, smart and complete system, active and streaming, that meets every requirement Terrason Audio sets for its systems. That promises something!

The Audio Specialists.en: The Audio Specialists is a distributor of top professional audio brands such as Tannoy, Midas and Lab Gruppen. From Apeldoorn, the team presents, as last year, the consumer audio brands Tannoy, Montaudio and Zeiler Audio. Unlike last year, there is also more attention for acoustics and design, with the special designs of Form At Wood. In room 80 the Tannoy Stirling III LZ Special Edition awaits you. Although the design of both the driver and the cabinet goes back to 1967, this speaker in its current form has the latest technology and is built with modern materials. There is also a combination of the Zeiler SP01 loudspeaker with Zeiler pre- and power amplification, placed on a Manuka MR Hi-Fi Rack system and cabled with Montaudio. Two products from Ultrafide Audio are in the spotlight: the U4PRE preamplifier and the U500DC stereo power amplifier.

Tonar International.en: Tonar International has been known since 1954 as a specialist in everything to do with analogue music reproduction. The Dutch company, known worldwide for supplying replacement styli for record players, original styli, cartridges and vinyl accessories, now has a range of more than 3,000 styli and over 1,500 different cartridges. With that, Tonar caters both to owners of classic turntables and to the modern audiophile who wants to get the most out of a beloved collection. Its range also includes head-fi from Grado, special cartridges from JICO and record cleaners from Tonar and Knosti.

Very Fine Solutions.en: Very Fine Solutions is always good for a listening room that ranks high on visitors’ lists, both in preparation (‘I HAVE to go there’) and afterwards, when savouring the memories. Led by Frank Vermeylen, the Belgian company focuses on music lovers who strive for the most natural and immersive listening experience possible. Its portfolio includes renowned brands such as MSB Technology, IKIGAI Audio and Artnovion, complemented by expert advice on system matching and room acoustics. One of the highlights will be the MSB Palisade DAC, which shows how well the ‘trickle-down’ principle can work in a ‘lower’ positioned model. After all, the Palisade is derived from MSB’s Cascade DAC, and that alone should be reason enough to come to room 119!

VIABLUE.en: German precision for the connection between components: that’s what you can count on with VIABLUE. For a quarter of a century the brand has focused on high-quality cables and accessories in which engineering, finish and functionality come together. For VIABLUE, cables are therefore more than a necessary part of an audio system: they must form a reliable, carefully constructed connection between the different components, and should therefore be seen as a component in their own right.

Vividsound.en: Vividsound focuses on music lovers who want maximum quality from a compact listening solution. To get that message across, the specialist in high-end in-ear monitors (IEMs) brings various models from Hisenior, Letshuoer and Unique Melody, among others. For example, you can get to know the Hisenior Mega7, a hybrid IEM with one dynamic driver and six balanced-armature drivers.

VoiceVictory & Hifi Fusion.en: VoiceVictory presents a striking combination of high-quality music reproduction, design, light and acoustics. In this room the VoiceVictory models POP, PREMIUM and SUPREME are played, while the room is dressed in a complete YourSenses atmosphere, in which sound, light, art, interior and acoustics come together in one sensory experience. HiFi-FUSION and the New Generation Audio concept are also back: less aloof, more design, more choice and more experience. One of the many interesting products in the range that our technical neighbours from the east are keen to introduce to you is the SC-4 Silver-Series speaker and power cable. But there is so much more in cables and accessories to see in this room.

Yabba Audio.en: This room is the stage for a selection of brands that are the cream of the crop in hi-fi experience. Italy’s Unison Research surprises us with two new models, the Unico PRE v2 preamplifier and the Unico DM v2 power amplifier. The pair is used to let the much-praised Monitor Audio Gold 300 6G sound in full glory. Just as Italian is Opera, both the term and style in music theatre and this brand. Opera has several lines, including the Callas. Transrotor captures everyone’s imagination with its Bellini and Rondino models. From Volumio there is the Primo v3 streaming DAC, accompanied by the Primo Plus and Lineo Duo external power supply. Power conditioning is entrusted to Isol-8, with the Powerline Extreme and the Isolink Vertex cable.

Yamaha Music Europe.en: In room 64, Yamaha focuses on the brand-new NX-70A streaming loudspeaker system and the TRUE X SURROUND 90A soundbar. The latter has already made many people wonder why you would buy loudspeakers at all if you both watch films and listen to music. This Height Beam soundbar offers a truly convincing Dolby Atmos experience, has wireless rear speakers that can even be used in another room, and is also compatible with Auro-3D and MusicCast. Listening to it will exceed all expectations. Oddly enough, the same goes for the NX-70A streaming loudspeaker system, which can be heard for the first time in the Benelux at DAE. If the form factor and finish don’t already convince you, the sound quality will. A classic stereo experience in an ultra-modern high-fidelity streaming jacket. Including YPAO room calibration and MusicCast! On top of all this, the Japanese brand has a real première with the new WXA-70A streaming amplifier, which can be heard together with the NS-600A monitor loudspeakers. Yamaha also has the R-N2000A and RX-500A network receivers and the brand-new R-200A stereo receiver on static display. The Holland Foyer features the headphone line-up, with the YH-5000, YH-4000, YH-C3000 and the HA-L7A headphone amplifier.
